challenge.method: I followed the formal closure definition on printed page 22 to the non-expansiveness grammar and identifier status restriction on printed page 21 and compared it with the earlier, general closure operator.
challenge.results: The valbind-specific closure uses the unique defining pat = exp for vid, then derives the quantified list from tyvars of its type less tyvars of C in the non-expansive case, and the empty list otherwise. The context-relative grammar governs which branch applies.

limitations: Free variables already present in the context are excluded from quantification. This result concerns the specialized closure operator after elaborating a value binding.
